headline: Groundwork for possible U.S. military action around Cuba is being laid, CBS News reports. An internal Army message reviewed by the network shows the Army Reserve assessing which forces could be needed within a 90 to 120 day window. The requests span medical, surgical, military police, engineering and logistics units, among them a combat sustainment support battalion, a medical brigade, a forward surgical detachment and a military police brigade. No deployment orders have been issued.
